name: Bauhaus
what_it_means: Rooted in the 1919 German art school, Bauhaus design reduces everything to primary colours and primary shapes. Bold geometric blocks, sans-serif type and functional composition create posters turned-interfaces that feel playful yet disciplined.
signature_moves: Primary colours: red, yellow, blue + black
Circles, squares, triangles as layout blocks
Flat colour, no gradients or shadows
best_for: Creative studios, museums, education, posters & events
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a hero section for [STUDIO / EVENT] in a Bauhaus style. Cream background (#F2EBDD). Compose the layout from large flat geometric shapes: a red (#D7263D) circle, a yellow (#F4B400) quarter-circle, a blue (#1E4CA1) square and a black triangle, overlapping on a hidden grid. Typography: a heavy geometric sans-serif (Futura / Archivo Black) in uppercase, with one word rotated 90°. Use thick black bars as dividers. No gradients, no shadows, no rounded cards. Buttons are flat rectangles in primary colours. Hover states swap colours between shapes.
